notes.title: Blitzkrieg 1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
We have released a patch for Blitzkrieg today to fix some nagging issues that slipped by player testing. Below is a full list of the changes we have made:
[list]
[*] Slight rebalance of the game's difficulty curve to keep the game challenging, not punishing.
[*] Recoloured armour in the game from Gold to Pink. This is to make the game more accessible for those with colour blindness.
[*] Fixed vehicle and projectile speeds being tied to frame rate. This made artillery unusable in some cases, and made the game harder on lower frame rates.
[*] Fixed steam achievements not triggering properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where Steam says the game is still playing - even though it isn't.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would close if Discord wasn't running.
[/list]
We have also collected lots of feedback from you guys during the first few weeks of release and are working on future improvements to be released soon!

We wish you the best holiday season, and have fun playing Blitzkrieg!
